div.h4:
May 26, 2026
Right down to the last sensor: Seamless Automation in the Packaging Line
div.div: In the packaging industry, efficiency is not an option—it is a requirement. Production lines must be fast, flexible, and above all, reliable. In this context, Murrelektronik presents a clear vision: holistic automation that connects all levels of the manufacturing system, to the very last field device. Join us as we walk through the different phases of a packaging production line and show how each step can be optimized with coordinated, purpose-built solutions.

a.class: btn btn-primary text-white stretched-link mb-0 me-auto

div.h4:
May 15, 2026
German Innovation Award for Vario-X: Murrelektronik receives award for cabinet-free automation
div.div: Murrelektronik has received the German Innovation Award for its automation platform Vario-X in the category “Excellence in Business-to-Business – Electronic Technologies”. The award recognizes an approach that fundamentally rethinks industrial automation: cabinet-free, modular, and implemented in a fully decentralized way directly at the machine.

a.class: btn btn-primary text-white stretched-link mb-0 me-auto

div.h4:
April 7, 2026
interpack 2026: Murrelektronik showcases decentralized automation for the packaging industry
div.div: At interpack 2026 in Düsseldorf, Murrelektronik (Hall 16, Stand C42) presents new decentralized approaches for the automation of packaging machines. The focus is on modular systems, digital services, and plug & play solutions that simplify installation, operation, and flexible use of machines.
